title: Caulfield and Malvern East, VIC internet outage (resolved)
current_summary:
Caulfield and surrounding areas including Malvern East (VIC). Interruption occurred from 8:43 pm to 9:22 pm AEST on 29 Sep 2026; services are restored.

nbn advises that this is a retrospective update confirming a network incident that impacted 6574 HFC customers in Caulfield, VIC and surrounding areas, between 20:43 and 21:22 AEST on 29/09/2026. The outage was caused by a network traffic drop on an aggregation link and was restored by a switch over of a Fibre Access Switch at the Caulfield optical node. All HFC customer services have been restored.

Resolution: nbn reset network equipment to restore service

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).

cause.reason: upstream network issue on an aggregation link
